scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @clipforge/shared && npm run build --workspace @clipforge/api && npm run build --workspace @clipforge/worker && npm run build --workspace @clipforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @clipforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @clipforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @clipforge/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @clipforge/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @clipforge/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @clipforge/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @clipforge/api" "npm run dev --workspace @clipforge/web"
